zh.title: 澳洲航空將於一個月內調整16小時空中巴士A380直飛航線
zh.summary: 澳洲航空調整超長程航線；將空中巴士A380更換為波音787-9客機
body: 根據航空媒體《Simple Flying》報導，澳洲航空（Qantas）計劃在一個月內結束一條航程長達16小時的空中巴士（Airbus）A380直飛航線。此決定是由於經濟艙需求放緩，促使澳洲航空選擇改用更具彈性的波音787-9客機來填補運能，而該航線的商務與頭等艙等高端艙等需求則依舊保持穩固。
在先前的航班時程規劃中，澳洲航空已將墨爾本至洛杉磯航線的最後一班空中巴士A380航班定於10月24日，並選擇改由波音787-9執飛。此外，該公司也在2026年8月宣佈，將把空中巴士A380機隊的退役時間由原本的2032財政年度提前至2028年。

en.title: Qantas to End a 16-Hour Nonstop Airbus A380 Route Within One Month
en.summary: Qantas to replace Airbus A380 with Boeing 787-9 capacity due to softened economy class demand.
body: According to Simple Flying, Qantas plans to end a 16-hour nonstop Airbus A380 route within one month. The decision is driven by softened demand in the economy cabin, which prompted the carrier to swap the superjumbo for more flexible Boeing 787-9 capacity. Demand for premium cabins on the route remains firm.

In previous schedule updates, Qantas scheduled its final Airbus A380 flight from Melbourne to Los Angeles for October 24, opting to utilize the Boeing 787-9 on that route. The airline also announced in August 2026 that it is bringing forward the retirement of its Airbus A380 fleet to 2028 from the fiscal year 2032.

zh.title: ONEflight暫停航班服務；1.5億美元預付資金恐有風險
zh.summary: ONEflight暫停航班服務；逾1.5億美元預付資金恐有風險
body: 總部位於科羅拉多州的私人噴射機包機經紀商ONEflight International已暫停航班服務，並表示將評估其業務運作。根據Private Jet Card Comparisons，受影響的預付客戶資金可能超過1.5億美元。
該公司於2026年9月16日確認暫停服務，並在其網站公告中表示，暫停將持續「未來30天，或直至另行通知」，同時公司正在評估其業務狀況。
ONEflight執行長Ferren Rajput向媒體表示，該公司並未持有客戶資金作為委託保管。公司銷售飛行卡，並透過第三方航空公司安排包機航班，客戶先存款以支付未來的旅行費用。
此次暫停服務前，已有報導指出O其中一些營運商報告支付困難，而另一些則報告沒有問題。公司內部電子郵件也坦承有財務及營運問題，但這些均屬初步報導。

en.title: ONEflight suspends flights; more than $150M in customer funds potentially at risk
en.summary: ONEflight suspends flights; >$150M in customer funds potentially at risk
body: ONEflight International, a Colorado-based private jet charter broker, has suspended flight services while it reviews its operations, with more than $150 million in prepaid customer funds potentially at risk, according to Private Jet Card Comparisons.
The company confirmed the suspension on September 16, 2026, and said in a website notice that the pause would last for the next 30 days or until further notice while it evaluates its business.

CEO Ferren Rajput told the publication that ONEflight does not hold customer funds in escrow. The broker sells jet cards and arranges charter flights through third-party operators, with customers depositing money for future travel.

The suspension follows earlier reports of payment difficulties, with some operators saying ONEflight had fallen behind on payments while others reported no problems. An internal email also acknowledged financial and operational issues, though details remain preliminary.

zh.title: 烏克蘭測試新型攔截器對抗噴射式沙赫德無人機
zh.summary: 澤倫斯基稱成功攔截；系統細節未公開
body: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在2026年9月15日的晚間談話中表示，烏克蘭已成功測試一款國產新型攔截器，用於對抗噴射動力的沙赫德（Shahed）攻擊無人機。他未透露該武器的名稱或製造商。
澤倫斯基說：「但一些技術層面仍須改良，這需要更多時間。」他未說明攔截器是無人機或飛彈、如何攔截目標，或何時能服役，也未提供性能數據或生產目標。
路透社報導，烏克蘭軍方稱當晚擊落187個空中目標。澤倫斯基表示，當晚攔截俄羅斯無人機的比例為93%，同時表示國家需做得更多以保護公民。
澤倫斯基僅披露新系統的一次成功交戰。這些數據描述烏克蘭整體防空努力。

en.title: Ukraine tests new interceptor against jet-powered Shahed drones, Zelensky says
en.summary: Zelensky reports successful interception; technical work continues
body: President Volodymyr Zelensky said in his nightly address on September 15, 2026, that Ukraine has successfully tested a domestically developed interceptor intended to counter jet-powered Shahed attack drones, according to the presidency's official English-language transcript. He did not identify the weapon or its manufacturer.

"But some technical aspects still need to be refined. It will take some more time," he said. He did not specify whether the interceptor is a drone or missile, how it engages its target, or when it could enter service, and provided no performance figures or production targets.

Reuters reported that Ukraine's military said it had downed 187 airborne targets overnight. Zelensky put the proportion of Russian drones intercepted that night at 93%, while saying the country needed to do more to protect its citizens.
Zelensky disclosed only one successful engagement involving the new system. The figures describe Ukraine's overall air defense effort.

zh.title: 葉門叛軍宣稱擊落沙烏地F-15戰機
zh.summary: 青年運動稱擊落沙烏地F-15；官方未證實
body: 葉門青年運動（Houthi）於2026年9月16日宣稱，在馬里卜省擊落一架沙烏地皇家空軍F-15戰機。截至發稿，沙烏地當局尚未對上述說法作出評論。
青年運動發言人葉海亞·薩雷（Yahya Saree）在該組織的馬西拉電視台發表的聲明中表示，戰機是被一枚當地製造的地對空飛彈擊落。但他並未說明交戰時間，也未指出所使用的飛彈系統。
薩雷還宣稱，青年運動的防空部隊隨後又向進入馬里卜空域的兩批沙烏地F-15及颱風戰鬥機發射了當地製造的飛彈。
此宣稱尚未被獨立驗證。截至發稿，沙烏地領導的聯軍及沙烏地國防部均未回應。

en.title: Houthis claim Saudi F-15 shootdown over Yemen; Riyadh silent
en.summary: Houthis claim Saudi F-15 shot down in Marib; unverified
body: Yemen's Houthi movement said on September 16, 2026, that it shot down a Royal Saudi Air Force F-15 over Marib Governorate. Saudi authorities had not commented on the claim as of publication.

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a statement carried by the group's al-Masirah television network that the fighter was downed by a locally made surface-to-air missile. He did not give a date for the engagement or identify the missile system used.

Saree also said Houthi air defenses subsequently fired further locally made missiles at two formations of Saudi F-15 and Eurofighter Typhoon jets that entered Marib airspace to search for the downed aircraft, and that the formations withdrew.
The claim has not been independently verified. Neither the Saudi-led coalition nor the Saudi Ministry of Defense had addressed the claim as of publication.

zh.title: 美國FAA撥款11億美元升級機場 裝設3000車輛發射器
zh.summary: FAA撥款11億美元升級機場；61機場3000車輛裝發射器
body: 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲（Sean P. Duffy）14日宣布，聯邦航空總署（FAA）將透過機場改善計畫（AIP）撥款11億美元，向46個州及三個屬地的機場發放280項補助，用於升級關鍵機場基礎設施、增設家庭友善設施，並安裝車輛活動區發射器（VMAT）以強化跑道安全。
此次撥款重點包括1090萬美元用於在61座機場的3000輛機場車輛裝設VMAT，協助空管人員追蹤跑道與滑行道上的車輛動態；4280萬美元補助10座機場執行噪音緩解專案；3070萬美元撥予亞特蘭大哈茲菲爾德-傑克遜國際機場進行跑道重建；1890萬美元支持路易斯安那州什里夫波特地區機場航廈擴建。
其他撥款包含1150萬美元予明尼蘇達州曼凱托地區機場新建管制塔、200萬美元予德州麥克艾倫國際機場擴建航廈（含行李轉盤、衛生間、哺乳室與售票櫃）。FAA署長布萊恩·貝德福德（Bryan Bedford）表示，這些補助將讓機場快速部署關鍵安全投資，給予空管人員管理日益複雜國家空域系統所需的工具與技術。
根據官方聲明，由於特朗普總統及國會共和黨通過《勞動家庭減稅法案》，FAA額外獲得1650萬美元，專門用於為所有FAA機場車輛裝設VMAT。除聯邦補助外，機場亦可動用AIP資金辦理跑道、滑行道、標誌、照明、標線等安全相關基礎設施專案。
FAA同步發布資料視覺化頁面，供公眾查看獲撥款機場清單。這項創紀錄投資旨在開啟「旅行黃金時代」，兼顧跑道安全升級與航廈旅客體驗提升。

en.title: U.S. FAA Awards $1.1 Billion for Airport Upgrades Including 3,000 Vehicle Transmitters
en.summary: FAA awards $1.1B for airport upgrades; 3,000 vehicles at 61 airports get transmitters
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced on September 14 that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will deliver $1.1 billion through the Airport Improvement Program (AIP) via 280 grants to airports in 46 states and three territories, targeting critical infrastructure upgrades, family-friendly terminal features, and installation of Vehicle Movement Area Transmitters (VMATs) on airport vehicles to enhance runway safety.

The funding highlights include $10.9 million to equip 3,000 airport vehicles with VMATs at 61 airports, helping air traffic controllers track vehicles on runways and taxiways; $42.8 million to 10 airports for noise mitigation projects; $30.7 million to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) for runway reconstruction; and $18.9 million to Shreveport Regional Airport (SHV) in Louisiana for terminal expansion.

Additional grants provide $11.5 million to Mankato Regional Airport (MKT) in Minnesota for a new contract tower, and $2 million to McAllen International Airport in Texas for terminal expansion including baggage claim, restrooms, nursing stations, and ticketing counters. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford stated the grants will allow airports to quickly deploy critical safety investments, giving controllers greater situational awareness to safely manage an increasingly complex National Airspace System.

The release notes that thanks to President Trump and Congressional Republicans' passage of the Working Families Tax Cut Act, the FAA received $16.5 million to equip all FAA airport vehicles with VMATs. Beyond federal grants, airports can also use AIP funding for runways, taxiways, signage, lighting, markings, and other safety-related infrastructure needs.

The FAA published a data visualization of airports receiving funding. The record investment aims to usher in a "Golden Age of Travel" by upgrading airport infrastructure, enhancing runway safety, and expanding family-friendly features in terminals nationwide.
